identity.title: Rotational and High-resolution Infrared Spectrum of HC<SUB>3</SUB>N: Global Ro-vibrational Analysis and Improved Line Catalog for Astrophysical Observations

paper_type_evidence.quote: These improved data, have enabled a refined analysis of the ALMA observations towards Sgr B2(N2).

evidence.quote: a velocity offset of $-1.0$ km s$^{-1}$ with respect to the assumed systemic velocity of Sgr B2(N2) of 74 km s$^{-1}$

question.value: Can a global ro-vibrational analysis of laboratory HC3N spectra give accurate rest frequencies, and does it improve the LTE modelling of vibrationally excited HC3N in the ALMA EMoCA spectrum of Sgr B2(N2)?

evidence.quote: perform a global fit of all the literature data with a careful treatment of the resonance effects

other_facilities.name: Laboratory FTIR and mm/submm spectrometers (Bologna, Garching, Cologne)

provided.value: New IR spectra 450-1350 cm-1 and rotational spectra up to ~1 THz of HC3N

evidence.quote: A substantial amount of new spectroscopic data of HC$_3$N have been collected in four laboratories located in Bologna, Cologne, and Munich.

what.value: ALMA EMoCA 3 mm spectral survey of Sgr B2(N2) and its LTE model parameters

evidence.quote: have recently published a complete 3 mm spectral survey of the hot molecular core Sgr B2(N2) performed with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

what.value: Experimental dipole moment of HC3N used for Einstein A

evidence.quote: computed using the experimental values of the dipole moment derived by (cite: DeLeon-JCP85-HC3N)

what.value: LTE model parameters: source size 0.9'', T=200 K, linewidth 5.8 km/s, offset -1.0 km/s, N=5.2e17 cm-2

evidence.quote: with the same parameters as derived in (cite: Belloche-AA16-EMoCA): a source size of 0.9$''$, a rotational temperature of 200 K

unstated_but_needed: EMoCA data reduction, calibration and imaging details
Exact spectral windows, frequencies and beam sizes used
Dipole moment value and the new line list file needed for WEEDS
Continuum subtraction and how blended species were modelled

analysis_steps.goal: Global ro-vibrational fit of lab data

method.value: Weighted least-squares fit of effective Hamiltonian to IR and rotational lines

evidence.quote: A different weighting factor, $w_i = 1/\sigma_i^2$ has been given to each $i$-th datum

fitting.value: Iterative least squares; some constants fixed from linear v-dependence

evidence.quote: The coefficients of the molecular Hamiltonian are optimised through an iterative least-squares procedure

analysis_steps.goal: Model Sgr B2(N2) HC3N spectrum with new predictions

method.value: LTE synthetic spectra overlaid on ALMA EMoCA spectrum, compared with old predictions

evidence.quote: We model the emission of the vibrationally excited states of HC$_3$N above $\varv_7 = 1$ assuming local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE)

validation.value: Visual comparison with spectrum using old vs new predictions

evidence.quote: it improves the agreement between the synthetic and observed spectra for $\varv_7 = 4$ and $\varv_5=\varv_7=1$

used_for.value: Computational core of the global fit

evidence.quote: uses the SPFIT program (cite: Pick-JMS91-calpgm) as the computational core

used_for.value: LTE synthetic spectra for Sgr B2(N2)

evidence.quote: The computation has been performed using the software WEEDS (cite: Maret-AA11-WEEDS)

findings_qualitative.value: New v6=1,v7=2 state of HC3N identified in EMoCA spectrum

evidence.quote: one previously unreported vibrational state of HC$_3$N ($\varv_6=1,\varv_7=2$) has been newly identified in the EMoCA observed spectra.

claims.hypothesis: Accurate treatment of resonances improves HC3N modelling in Sgr B2(N2)
claims.experiment: LTE models with new vs old predictions compared with EMoCA spectrum
claims.result: Inconsistencies for v7=4 and v5=v7=1 resolved; v4=1 and v6=2 unchanged

evidence.quote: Discrepancies between observations and the global model (cite: Belloche-AA16-EMoCA), produced by perturbed HC$_3$N ro-vibrational lines, could be effectively removed.

referee_caveats_inferred: Agreement judged visually, no quantitative fit statistics
